verdict.description: fits: what the design needs from this level is built from what it provides, or the level grows with a stated reason. widens: the design asks this level for something outside its vocabulary without saying why combining what it provides could not do. misplaced: a part the design places in this level belongs in another one.

reason.description: Why, in this level's terms: which of its primitives the need is or is not built from, or which level the misplaced part belongs in.

cites.description: What the reason rests on: the design's element or claim ids, and file:line where you read the code.
